inspiration.observed_pattern: A NATURAL RIGHT JOIN combines two derived relations whose shared columns came from inner NATURAL JOIN projections.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed key in both derived relations and one right-only key, retaining natural shared-column matching and right-side null extension while removing the inventory labels and names.

fixture_notes: Key 7 matches across the derived relations and key 9 exists only on the right, so the result must contain one populated row and one row with a NULL left value.
determinism_notes: The two fixed derived rows and stable numeric ordering contain no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_inventory_keys (key_id INT PRIMARY KEY, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_inventory_labels (key_id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, label_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (key_id, zone_code))
CREATE TABLE mini_inventory_states (key_id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, state_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (key_id, zone_code))

steps.sql: SELECT right_side.key_id, left_side.label_code, right_side.state_code FROM (SELECT key_id, zone_code, label_code FROM mini_inventory_keys NATURAL JOIN mini_inventory_labels) AS left_side NATURAL RIGHT JOIN (SELECT key_id, zone_code, state_code FROM mini_inventory_keys NATURAL JOIN mini_inventory_states) AS right_side ORDER BY right_side.key_id, left_side.label_code, right_side.state_code
